The '''Eye of Asteria''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located at {{Location|Black Shores Archipelago}}.

==Overview==
The Eye of Asteria is a part of one of the islands belonging to [[The Black Shores]]. It's the highest point of the [[Black Shores]] located close to [[Haven of Sprouts]] and, according to [[Monica]], is responsible for monitoring the [[Etheric Sea]] across [[Solaris-3]].<ref name="ARTICLE" /> While the whole archipelago stands upon [[Tacetite]], the Eye of Asteria's Tacetite is more powerful, making the interference stronger, thus causing it to not have much infrastructure.<ref name="HBtW">[[Main Quest]] ''[[Hidden Between the Waves]]'' in [[Chapter I]]: Act VIII - ''[[To the Shore's End]]''
:'''''Monica:''' The island ahead is the Eye of Asteria, the highest point in the Black Shores.''
:'''''Monica:''' It monitors the Etheric Sea across all of Solaris. Since the Tacetite there is more powerful, the interference is stronger, so there's not as much infrastructure there.''
:'''''Monica:''' It's quite close to the Haven of Sprouts. The robot is already there waiting for you.''</ref>

[[Rover]] first goes to the Eye of Asteria when solving the abnormal frequencies of the Black Shores in [[Main Quest]] ''[[Hidden Between the Waves]]'' in [[Chapter I]]: Act VIII - ''[[To the Shore's End]]''.<ref name="HBtW" />
